scope: Candidates 11-20 of frozen P0 manifest; Claude first pass plus coordinator original-source corrections; model predictions not inspected
method_note: Eligibility judged from cited original sources and regulatory CTD. FRDB Cmax values were read only after prediction seal and used to map duplicate-dose row IDs to original table cells; they were not used as target labels when an original value differed. AI-assisted draft, not independent human verification. Original-source access and every correction are documented per arm.
unresolved_issues: Original full texts remain inaccessible for zenarestat, genistein, phendimetrazine and cloprednol; their cited arms cannot be scored without source verification.
GIT-027 dosage form/IR status is not reported in accessible original article text, despite readable Cmax for seven arms.
Phloroglucinol ODT and atabecestat oral suspension require an explicit primary-scope interpretation before scoring; no predictions have been inspected.
Mozavaptan nominal dose is the hydrochloride-salt amount; this is recorded and has not been converted after prediction seal.
FRDB frdb_10765 has a Cmax transcription discrepancy (9.83 versus original 9.38 μg/mL); original value must be used.
